title: Scalable ultrasound-assisted synthesis of hydroxy imidazole N-oxides and evaluation of their anti-proliferative activities; mechanistic insights into the deoximation of dioximes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,938-946
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07893D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Munna Mukhia, Sagar Rai, Yachna Rai, Koushik Chakraborty, Sangita Dey, Bipransh Kumar Tiwary, Dhiraj Brahman, Anoop Kumar, Kiran Pradhan
Ultrasound irradiation serves as a greener and efficient method for the synthesis of Hydroxy Imidazole N-oxides via the acid-catalysed iminoketone-aldehyde condensations. Highly pure products with high yields obtained in very less time.
